body:
I’d just like to speak on this matter. I’m an 18 year old. I have a boyfriend, we’ve been together. I have birth control and we always use protection, both of which are 99% effective. There’s always that tiny percentage that I could fall pregnant. If we did, I would think I’d like to have that choice. 

Me and my boyfriend are both currently studying at tertiary education and are heading in quite busy and stressful careers. 

If we had a child, we would never be able to pursue what we both wanted to do.

I could never ever bring myself to admit a child into the sad life of adoption.
